code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, mild leukopenia with neutropenia, elevated RDW, and increased inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH, D-dimer). There is also mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine) and coagulopathy (elevated INR). These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and risk of bleeding or thrombotic complications. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
